The '''sea-snake''',<ref name="CSWE" /> or '''seasnake''', was a ribbonlike [[Water/Legends|aquatic]] [[Snake/Legends|snake]]<ref name="CatCW" /> [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] to the<ref name="CSWE" /> [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Riome]].<ref name="CSWE" /> Sea-snakes were among the millions of aquatic creatures living in the [[Royal Icqui Aquaria]] on the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] planet [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="CatCW" />

==Behind the scenes==
Sea-snakes were first mentioned in the [[2003]] ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]'' sourcebook ''[[Coruscant and the Core Worlds]]'', published by [[Wizards of the Coast]], where they were referred to as "seasnakes."<ref name="CatCW" /> The [[2008]] reference book ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'' identified the creatures as sea-snakes.<ref name="CSWE" />
